adoption.negative_or_nonpositive_required_positiv: Reject candidate when net/segment/stress fails required sign; count insufficiency separately marks insufficient evidence
adoption.no_inference: Passing is a research screen, not proven edge or live deployment approval

candidate.cancellation: Known post-t0 completed H1 SL touch, H1 close at/inside boundary, or fixed TP touch; completed 4H direction invalid; current known open at/beyond SL or TP. All cancellations and exact expiry before delay_wait; completed bar SL then close then TP, trend, current open SL then TP, expiry.
candidate.delay: D0 at corresponding t0 open, D1 waits one hour, D2 two hours; skipped hours still process all known invalidations.
candidate.inside_quote: At/inside boundary quote alone rejects current quote, but does not cancel without completed H1 close evidence.
candidate.quote: long boundary < current open < TP; short TP < current open < boundary
candidate.ratio: cost-adjusted full-TP net / cost-adjusted original-SL loss >= 1
candidate.suppression_order: raw no_target recorded before suppression. A valid-target raw signal with active candidate/position is suppressed and never reinserted. Existing position still active at same timestamp takes precedence even if an open exit will follow.

costs.actual_funding: all settlements actually held, based on exit funding_through
costs.funding_base: raw entry quote * quantity, both long and short pay
costs.no_double_count: Execution slippage/spread/rounding are contained in fills, decomposed for reporting but not deducted twice
costs.planned_funding: all settlements in (entry, entry+6h] at full quantity
costs.rounding: Against trader on entry and exit

data_policy.current_299_hour_sample: Less than 100 complete 4H warmup; cannot support eligible main results. No opportunity/return claim from it.
data_policy.gaps: Report data insufficient and do not run a portfolio across a gap
data_policy.incomplete_H1: Exclude any H1 with close_time > run end

evaluation.account_reset: Each large period starts flat with equity 1000; indicators do not reset. Period results cannot be added as one compounded year. Initial signal may use completed pre-period bars. Validation midpoint does not reset account.
evaluation.earlier_purpose: description and implementation verification only, never parameter choice
evaluation.run_timing: Record actual UTC start/end per period and variant; protocol hash must match. All implementation defect corrections logged and all fixed runs repeated.
evaluation.tail: Causal execution first; report-time censor any trade without observed entry+6h open, even if earlier exit observed. Censored trades excluded from principal P&L. Never filter entries using future availability.

execution.entry_lookahead: Only current open known for admission; never use current H/L to reject entry
execution.funding_open_order: Exit exactly at settlement includes funding; entry exactly at settlement excludes already passed funding
execution.gap_stop: worse current open if past SL
execution.gap_target: fixed TP, not favorable gap open
execution.holding: Original SL and TP only; no exits due to new 4H direction or H1 close reversal
execution.intrabar_ambiguity: SL first if SL and TP both touched in one bar
execution.intrabar_exit: timestamp proxy bar_end-1ms; funding through bar_open only
execution.proxy: Hourly opens only, not :03 or actual 15-minute fills
execution.timeout: entry+6h current open; before current bar HL, after known gap SL

h1_signal.b0: previous complete H1 immediately before b1
h1_signal.long: b0.close < b0.open and b1.close > b0.high and b1.low > b0.low
h1_signal.raw: trend and H1 pattern match; one raw signal per t0. No target raw signals logged as no_target, not candidates.
h1_signal.short: b0.close > b0.open and b1.close < b0.low and b1.high < b0.high

hypothesis: A completed one-hour recovery from a one-hour pullback in an established four-hour trend may resume to the nearest already observed confirmed swing structure.
modification_policy: Never overwrite frozen protocol. Implementation bugs may be fixed only to conform to this protocol, with red regression evidence and all historical runs repeated; parameter changes require new independent protocol and are outside this task.

parameter_rationale.3h_entry_6h_hold: Short bounded stale-signal exposure and identical execution comparison
parameter_rationale.4H_EMA20: Separately establishes direction on a slower timeframe without selecting a winning lookback
parameter_rationale.72h_2x2_swing: Finite recent observed market structure, confirmation delay explicitly causal
parameter_rationale.costs: Prespecified adverse execution and funding stresses, not inferred historical realized costs
parameter_rationale.one_H1_pullback_reclaim: Tests immediate recovery after a single opposite-color hour, rather than another N-hour breakout
parameter_rationale.ratio_1: Minimum full-cost reward/risk hypothesis, unproven; fixed before outcomes

purpose: One fixed hypothesis; no parameter selection, trading, deployment or changes to existing tasks.
report: net/trade count/win rate/profit factor/mean median per-trade net
planned ratio distribution and actual net/planned risk distribution
realized and close-marked drawdown in USDT and peak percent

sizing.maintenance_caveat: Only simulation pressure, not actual exchange liquidation model
sizing.minimum_check: full single quantity times minimum of entry, fixed SL exit, fixed TP exit stressed fills >= 5

target.lock: one full-quantity TP locked at t0; never move. No projections or fallback R target. No target means no candidate.
target.long_choice: smallest swing high price strictly greater than b1.close
target.short_choice: largest swing low price strictly less than b1.close
target.source: strict confirmed observed H1 swing high for long, swing low for short

trend.ema_seed: SMA of first 20 complete four-hour closes
trend.incomplete_group: excluded; update EMA on complete groups only
trend.long: latest completed 4H close > EMA20 and EMA20 > prior complete 4H EMA20
trend.otherwise: neutral, no raw signal; invalidates pending candidate
trend.short: latest completed 4H close < EMA20 and EMA20 < prior complete 4H EMA20
